Take this silver feather and use it to bind my sight to that of them.$B$BBeing able to see our enemy's movements will grant us the strategic advantage we need.  You'll find abundant eagles in the mountains to the east.

Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!$B$BI warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.$B$BPlease, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!

1fea9b6018d714326210858a454d6a1b7b5033e6.LogDescription: Speak with Huntress Kella Nightbow near Valaar's Berth.
1fea9b6018d714326210858a454d6a1b7b5033e6.QuestDescription: Huntress Kella Nightbow seeks the audience of all eligible hunters.  She is the one to teach you the skill of taming wild beasts, a lesson you should learn above all else at this point in your training.$b$bKella can be found near Valaar's Berth, the docks west of the Exodar.

1feb733c81affbe1c9a59ed67fcf0162969a2b61.CompletionText: Alliance or Horde, it doesn't matter - no being deserves to be trapped on this world as a tortured spirit.  The freeing of these souls will make things right, $N.

1febe14011627fd12868e07c82019290cbef2c4a.LogDescription: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Force Commander Danath Trollbane in Honor Hold.
1febe14011627fd12868e07c82019290cbef2c4a.QuestDescription: The permanence of the orcish threat is one of the sad truths of Outland. There was a time when we Sons of Lothar believed we'd purchased Honor Hold's safety with our blood, but there was to be no peace.$B$BThe Sons will yield to no orc - green, brown, and now red - we will overcome them or die trying. If we are to have any expectation of victory, we must take the fight to them in Hellfire Citadel. Bring me the weapon of their self-styled 'Warchief' Kargath Bladefist and you will be well rewarded.

texts.text0_0: The captain's great!  We get time to relax when we dock.  Those are the times I look forward to the most.

1fed95e7f143adab9eb2ec4a5611c2fa850c7bf9.LogDescription: Speak with Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
1fed95e7f143adab9eb2ec4a5611c2fa850c7bf9.QuestDescription: $N, now that you can see me, there is something you must tell Rexxar. I know that he seeks his people, and I know where they are.$B$BThe Mok'Nathal, as they are known, have a village to the east beyond the Razor Ridge.$B$BGo, give Rexxar this news. His people are in danger, and I know that he will want to come to their aid.

1ff61c9f795ee5691aa2b24252be959e2ab31a45.LogDescription: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Malar Bravehorn, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
1ff61c9f795ee5691aa2b24252be959e2ab31a45.QuestDescription: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, $N. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty tauren in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.
